parsed_json.sql: SELECT m.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, r.compound_key, COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi, a.description AS assay_description, act.standard_type, act.standard_relation, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.activity_comment, t.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, t.pref_name AS target_name, t.organism AS target_organism FROM molecule_dictionary m JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = m.molregno JOIN compound_records r ON r.molregno = m.molregno JOIN docs d ON d.doc_id = r.doc_id JOIN activities act ON act.record_id = r.record_id JOIN assays a ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON t.tid = a.tid WHERE t.pref_name = 'JAK2' AND act.standard_type = 'IC50' ORDER BY m.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, r.compound_key, COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi), a.description, act.standard_type, act.standard_relation, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.activity_comment, t.chembl_id, t.pref_name, t.organism
